Anyway: yes. if I put a callback on a gate, then it's triggered when the gate is operated. so i don't have to put the callback on the device's "clock pulse", just on the gate. but if I want to get a message back each time we check the CPU value, then it's gonna be time interval based. which means on each "clock pulse", we should have something in the system device's ground loop folder that will call back if the specified interval has passed since the last one. which means we need a place to keep a counter on that callback too.
